points.description: Names dams (or reservoirs / storage structures that store water) as one of the structures constructed.
Names reservoirs or canals (water conveyance/transfer channels) as the second structure. Either 'reservoir' or 'canal' is accepted.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming two correct structures such as dams and reservoirs, or dams and canals, in any wording. Give 1 mark if only one correct structure is given or the answer is vague (e.g. 'storage structures'). Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
